title: Recording: The Day The World Gets ’Round by George Harrison | 1972
content:
Apple Studios, London
Producer: George Harrison
Engineer: Phil McDonald

George Harrison recorded ‘The Day The World Gets ’Round’, for his fourth solo album Living In The Material World, on 4 October 1972.

The basic track had Klaus Voormann’s bass guitar on track one, and Jim Keltner’s drums on two and three. Three acoustic guitars, played by Harrison and Pete Ham and Joey Molland of Badfinger, were recorded onto tracks five and six. Nicky Hopkins’s piano was recorded on seven and eight, and Harrison’s vocals were on track 10. From take five a harmonium, played by Gary Wright, was on track 12.

Forty-six takes were recorded, with various changes made to the arrangement as the session progressed. Take 46 was marked as best and became the album version.
